        "contents": "//\n//  CarouselView.swift\n//  My First Swift\n//\n//  Created by Evan Robinson on 12/9/25.\n//  Updated to use SwiftCarousel library\n//\n\nimport SwiftUI\n\nstruct CarouselView: View {\n    let title: String\n    let items: [Ingredient]\n    @Binding var selectedIndex: Int\n    let onItemSelected: (Ingredient) -&gt; Void\n    \n    // TEMPORARY: Optional mapping for style short descriptions\n    // Remove this parameter when we have actual style assets\n    var styleShortDescriptions: [String: String]? = nil\n    \n    // Optional custom tile size (for 4-carousel view to fit on screen)\n    var customTileSize: CGFloat? = nil\n    \n    // Convert Ingredient to CarouselItem for SwiftCarousel\n    private var carouselItems: [CarouselItem] {\n        return items.map { ingredient in\n            // TEMPORARY: For style items (art_style category), include short description\n            // This is for placeholder tile overlays until we have actual assets\n            // Remove the shortDescription parameter when assets are available\n            let shortDesc: String? = (ingredient.category == \"art_style\") \n                ? styleShortDescriptions?[ingredient.id] \n                : nil\n            \n            return CarouselItem(\n                id: ingredient.id,\n                imageURL: ingredient.imageURL,\n                displayName: ingredient.name,\n                shortDescription: shortDesc\n            )\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Binding for SwiftCarousel (uses Int? instead of Int)\n    private var selectedIndexBinding: Binding&lt;Int?&gt; {\n        Binding(\n            get: { selectedIndex &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; selectedIndex &lt; items.count ? selectedIndex : nil },\n            set: { newValue in\n                if let newValue = newValue, newValue &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; newValue &lt; items.count {\n                    selectedIndex = newValue\n                } else {\n                    selectedIndex = -1\n                }\n            }\n        )\n    }\n    \n    // Carousel configuration - larger tiles for expanded rows\n    // Use custom size if provided (for 4-carousel view), otherwise default to 280\n    private var carouselConfig: CarouselConfig {\n        ",

        "contents": "//\n//  CarouselItem.swift\n//  SwiftCarousel\n//\n//  Created by Evan Robinson on 12/11/25.\n//\n\nimport SwiftUI\n\nstruct CarouselItem: Identifiable {\n    let id: String\n    let imageName: String?      // Optional: for bundle-based images\n    let imageURL: String?       // Optional: for URL-based images\n    let displayName: String\n    let shortDescription: String? // Optional: short description (1-4 words) for placeholder tiles\n    \n    // Convenience initializer for bundle-based images (backward compatible)\n    init(id: String, imageName: String, displayName: String, shortDescription: String? = nil) {\n        self.id = id\n        self.imageName = imageName\n        self.imageURL = nil\n        self.displayName = displayName\n        self.shortDescription = shortDescription\n    }\n    \n    // Initializer for URL-based images\n    init(id: String, imageURL: String, displayName: String, shortDescription: String? = nil) {\n        self.id = id\n        self.imageName = nil\n        self.imageURL = imageURL\n        self.displayName = displayName\n        self.shortDescription = shortDescription\n    }\n    \n    // Full initializer for both (URL takes precedence)\n    init(id: String, imageName: String? = nil, imageURL: String? = nil, displayName: String, shortDescription: String? = nil) {\n        self.id = id\n        self.imageName = imageName\n        self.imageURL = imageURL\n        self.displayName = displayName\n        self.shortDescription = shortDescription\n    }\n    \n    static func sampleItems(count: Int = 15) -&gt; [CarouselItem] {\n        let imageNames = [\n            \"01_star_puppy\",\n            \"02_star_kitten\",",

        "contents": "//\n//  Carousel.swift\n//  SwiftCarousel\n//\n//  Created by Evan Robinson on 12/11/25.\n//\n\nimport SwiftUI\n\nstruct Carousel: View {\n    let items: [CarouselItem]\n    @Binding var selectedIndex: Int?\n    let config: CarouselConfig\n    var onSelect: ((CarouselItem) -&gt; Void)? = nil\n    \n    var body: some View {\n        ScrollView(.horizontal, showsIndicators: false) {\n            HStack(spacing: config.tileSpacing) {\n                // Leading padding\n                Spacer()\n                    .frame(width: config.horizontalPadding)\n                \n                // Tiles\n                ForEach(Array(items.enumerated()), id: \\.element.id) { index, item in\n                    Button(action: {\n                        handleTap(at: index, item: item)\n                    }) {\n                        TileView(\n                            item: item,\n                            config: config,\n                            isSelected: selectedIndex == index\n                        )\n                    }\n                    .buttonStyle(PlainButtonStyle())\n                }\n                \n                // Trailing padding\n                Spacer()\n                    .frame(width: config.horizontalPadding)\n            }\n            .padding(.vertical, calculateVerticalPaddingForScale())\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func handleTap(at index: Int, item: CarouselItem) {\n        // If tapping the already selected item, deselect it\n        if selectedIndex == index {\n            selectedIndex = nil\n            return\n        }\n        \n        // Update selection\n        selectedIndex = index\n        onSelect?(item)\n    }\n    \n    // Calculate vertical padding needed inside ScrollView to prevent clipping\n    private func calculateVerticalPaddingForScale() -&gt; CGFloat {\n        // Scale grows from center, so growth in each direction = (scale - 1) * height / 2",

        "contents": "    // Use custom size if provided (for 4-carousel view), otherwise default to 280\n    private var carouselConfig: CarouselConfig {\n        var config = CarouselConfig.default()\n        let tileSize = customTileSize ?? 280 // Default 280, smaller for 4-carousel view\n        config.tileWidth = tileSize\n        config.tileHeight = tileSize\n        config.tileSpacing = 16\n        config.horizontalPadding = 20\n        return config\n    }\n    \n    var body: some View {\n            // Use SwiftCarousel for horizontal scrolling\n            Carousel(\n                items: carouselItems,\n                selectedIndex: selectedIndexBinding,\n                config: carouselConfig,\n                onSelect: { carouselItem in\n                    // Find the corresponding Ingredient and call the callback\n                    if let index = items.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == carouselItem.id }) {\n                        selectedIndex = index\n                        onItemSelected(items[index])\n                    }\n                }\n            )\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "//\n//  MainViewModel.swift\n//  My First Swift\n//\n//  Created by Evan Robinson on 12/9/25.\n//\n\nimport Foundation\nimport SwiftUI\nimport Combine\n\nenum GenerationButtonState: Sendable {\n    case notReady\n    case ready\n    case generating\n    \n    var id: Int {\n        switch self {\n        case .notReady: return 0\n        case .ready: return 1\n        case .generating: return 2\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nclass MainViewModel: ObservableObject {\n    private let apiClient = APIClient.shared\n    private let sseService = SSEService.shared\n    private let assetsService = AssetsService.shared\n    private var cancellables = Set&lt;AnyCancellable&gt;()\n    private var imageGenerationTask: Task&lt;Void, Never&gt;?\n    \n    // View mode - controls which layout is displayed\n    @Published var viewMode: ViewMode = .default {\n        didSet {\n            // Persist view mode selection\n            UserDefaults.standard.set(viewMode.rawValue, forKey: \"viewMode\")\n            // Load style items when switching to fourCarousel mode\n            if viewMode == .fourCarousel &amp;&amp;         "contents": "//\n//  TileView.swift\n//  SwiftCarousel\n//\n//  Created by Evan Robinson on 12/11/25.\n//\n\nimport SwiftUI\nimport UIKit\n\nstruct TileView: View {\n    let item: CarouselItem\n    let config: CarouselConfig\n    let isSelected: Bool\n    \n    @State private var pulseScale: CGFloat = 1.0\n    @State private var loadedImage: UIImage? = nil\n    @State private var isLoading: Bool = false\n    @State private var loadError: Bool = false\n    \n    var body: some View {\n        Group {\n            if let image = loadedImage {\n                // Successfully loaded image\n                Image(uiImage: image)\n                    .resizable()\n                    .aspectRatio(contentMode: .fill)\n                    .frame(width: config.tileWidth, height: config.tileHeight)\n                    .clipped()\n                    .cornerRadius(config.cornerRadius)\n                    .overlay(\n                        // Selection border\n                        RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: config.cornerRadius)\n                            .stroke(\n                                config.selectionBorderColor,\n                                lineWidth: isSelected ? config.selectionBorderWidth : 0\n                            )\n                    )\n                    .scaleEffect(isSelected ? config.selectionScaleFactor * pulseScale : 1.0)\n                    .animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.15), value: isSelected)\n            } else if item.imageURL == nil {\n                // Style placeholder tile (no image URL) - use custom placeholder\n                // TEMPORARY: Passing shortDescription for overlay until we have actual assets\n                StylePlaceholderTile(\n                    styleName: item.displayName,\n                    shortDescription: item.shortDescription\n                )\n                    .frame(width: config.tileWidth, height: config.tileHeight)",

it handles API keys automatically\n                    if let image = try await ImageCache.shared.loadImage(from: url) {\n                        await MainActor.run {\n                            self.loadedImage = image\n                            self.isLoading = false\n                            self.loadError = false\n                        }\n                    } else {\n                        await MainActor.run {\n                            self.isLoading = false\n                            self.loadError = true\n                        }\n                        // Fall back to bundle loading if URL fails\n                        if let bundleImage = loadBundleImage() {\n                            await MainActor.run {\n                                self.loadedImage = bundleImage\n                                self.loadError = false\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                } catch {\n                    print(\"❌ TileView: Error loading '\\(item.displayName)': \\(error.localizedDescription)\")\n                    await MainActor.run {\n                        self.isLoading = false\n                        self.loadError = true\n                    }\n                    // Fall back to bundle loading if URL fails\n                    if let bundleImage = loadBundleImage() {\n                        await MainActor.run {\n                            self.loadedImage = bundleImage\n                            self.loadError = false\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            return\n        }\n        \n        // Priority 2: Load from bundle (backward compatible)\n        if let bundleImage = loadBundleImage() {\n            ",

{\n        guard let data = UserDefaults.standard.data(forKey: playlistCacheKey),\n              ",

        "contents": "//\n//  WaypointGameViewModel.swift\n//  My First Swift\n//\n//  Created for Waypoint Navigation Minigame\n//\n\nimport Foundation\nimport SwiftUI\nimport Combine\nimport UIKit\n\nclass WaypointGameViewModel: ObservableObject {\n    @Published var gameState = WaypointGameState()\n    \n    private var cancellables = Set&lt;AnyCancellable&gt;()\n    private var buggyAnimationTimer: Timer?\n    private var pulseTimer: Timer?\n    let audioService = WaypointGameAudioService()\n    \n    // Asset base URL - uses centralized ServerConfig\n    // Uses Assets API route for nested directory structure\n    private var assetBaseURL: String {\n        let base = ServerConfig.shared.baseURL\n        return \"\\(base)/static/assets/minigames/waypoint\"\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Initialization\n    \n    init() {\n        loadDefaultWaypoints()\n        setupPulseAnimation()\n    }\n    \n    deinit {\n        buggyAnimationTimer?.invalidate()\n        pulseTimer?.invalidate()\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Game Setup\n    \n    func loadDefaultWaypoints() {\n        gameState.waypoints = WaypointGameState.defaultWaypoints()\n        \n        // Build good nodes order\n        let goodNodes = gameState.waypoints.filter { $0.isTraversable }\n        gameState.totalGoodNodes = goodNodes.count\n        gameState.goodNodesOrder = gameState.waypoints\n            .enumerated()\n            .filter { $0.element.isTraversable }\n            .map { $0.offset }\n        gameState.currentGoodNodeIndex = 0\n        \n        updateStatusMessage()\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Asset Loading\n    \n    func loadAssets() async {\n        print(\"🎮 Starting asset loading...\")\n        print(\"📍 Asset base URL: \\(assetBaseURL)\")\n        await loadCriticalAssets()\n        // Pre-load victory assets in background\n        Task {\n            await loadVictoryAssets()\n        }\n        // Start background music\n        audioService.playBackgroundMusic()\n    }\n    \n    private func loadCriticalAssets() async {\n        // Load buggy sprite\n        let buggyURLString = \"\\(assetBaseURL)/moon_buggy_sprite.png\"",

        "contents": "# View Mode System - Implementation Plan\n\n## Overview\nAdd a view mode selection system that allows switching between different main view layouts. Start with DEFAULT (current) and add a new 4-CAROUSEL mode with style selection.\n\n## Acceptance Criteria\n1. ✅ Default view works unchanged\n2. ✅ View mode selectable from Settings menu\n3. ✅ 4th carousel bottom-aligned with preview drawer\n4. ✅ 4th reference image included in generation when in 4-carousel mode\n5. ✅ GPT prompt modified to use style input\n\n---\n\n## Step-by-Step Implementation Plan\n\n### Phase 1: View Mode Infrastructure (Foundation)\n\n#### Step 1.1: Create View Mode Enum\n**File:** &#96;Models/ViewMode.swift&#96; (NEW)\n- Enum: &#96;ViewMode&#96; with cases:\n  - &#96;.default&#96; (current 3-carousel view)\n  - &#96;.fourCarousel&#96; (new 4-carousel view)\n- Make it &#96;Codable&#96; for persistence\n- Add &#96;displayName: String&#96; computed property\n\n#### Step 1.2: Add View Mode State to MainViewModel\n**File:** &#96;ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift&#96;\n- Add &#96;@Published var viewMode: ViewMode = .default&#96;\n- Add &#96;@Published var styleIndex: Int = -1&#96; (for 4th carousel)\n- Add &#96;@Published var styleItems: [Ingredient] = []&#96; (placeholder styles)\n- Update &#96;allSelectionsReady&#96; computed property:\n  - Default mode: requires friend, outfit, place (3 selections)\n  - FourCarousel mode: requires friend, outfit, place, style (4 selections)\n\n#### Step 1.3: Persist View Mode Selection\n**File:** &#96;ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift&#96;\n- Save &#96;viewMode&#96; to UserDefaults on change\n- Load &#96;viewMode&#96; from UserDefaults in &#96;init()&#96;\n- Add &#96;func setViewMode(_ mode: ViewMode)&#96; method\n\n---\n\n### Phase 2: Settings UI (View Selection)\n\n#### Step 2.1: Add View Mode Selector to Settings\n**File:** &#96;Views/Components/SettingsView.swift&#96;\n- Add new section: \"View Mode\" above Music Controls\n- Add &#96;@ObservedObject var viewModel: MainViewModel&#96; parameter\n- Create &#96;ViewModeSelector&#96; component:\n  - Shows current view mode",
        "signatures": {},

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"//\\n//  MainViewModel.swift\\n//  My First Swift\\n//\\n//  Created by Evan Robinson on 12/9/25.\\n//\\n\\nimport Foundation\\nimport SwiftUI\\nimport Combine\\n\\nenum GenerationButtonState: Sendable {\\n    case notReady\\n    case ready\\n    case generating\\n    \\n    var id: Int {\\n        switch self {\\n        case .notReady: return 0\\n        case .ready: return 1\\n        case .generating: return 2\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\nclass MainViewModel: ObservableObject {\\n    private let apiClient = APIClient.shared\\n    private let sseService = SSEService.shared\\n    private let assetsService = AssetsService.shared\\n    private var cancellables = Set&amp;lt;AnyCancellable&amp;gt;()\\n    private var imageGenerationTask: Task&amp;lt;Void, Never&amp;gt;?\\n    \\n    // View mode - controls which layout is displayed\\n    @Published var viewMode: ViewMode = .default {\\n        didSet {\\n            // Persist view mode selection\\n            UserDefaults.standard.set(viewMode.rawValue, forKey: \\\"viewMode\\\")\\n            // Load style items when switching to fourCarousel mode\\n            if viewMode == .fourCarousel &amp;amp;&amp;amp; styleItems.isEmpty {\\n                loadStyleItems()\\n            }\\n        }\\n    }\\n    \\n    // Carousel indices\\n    @Published var friendIndex = -1\\n    @Published var outfitIndex = -1\\n    @Published var placeIndex = -1\\n    @Published var styleIndex = -1 // For 4th carousel (style/medium)\\n    \\n    // Ingredients by category (filtered from API)\\n    @Published var friendItems: [Ingredient] = []\\n    @Published var outfitItems: [Ingredient] = []\\n    @Published var placeItems: [Ingredient] = []\\n    @Published var styleItems: [Ingredient] = [] // Placeholder style items\\n    \\n    // Preview and history\\n    @Published var previewImage: UIImage?\\n    @Published var historyImages: [GeneratedImage] = []\\n    \\n    // Background image\\n    @Published var backgroundImage: UIImage?\\n    \\n    // Button state\\n    @Published var buttonState: GenerationButtonState = .notReady\\n    \\n    // Loading states\\n    @Published var isLoadingIngredients = false\\n    @Published var isLoadingHistory = false\\n    @Published var isCreatingImage = false\","

                  "lineNumber": 1834,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# Drawer Migration Plan: Two-Column to Full-Width with Overlay Drawer\\n\\n**Date:** December 2025  \\n**Goal:** Migrate from 55%/45% split layout to full-width carousels with right-side overlay drawer\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Current State Analysis\\n\\n### Current Structure\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\nMainView\\n├── HStack (spacing: 0)\\n│   ├── CombinedColumnView (55% width)\\n│   │   └── 3 Carousels (Friend, Outfit, Place)\\n│   └── RightColumnView (45% width)\\n│       ├── Preview Section\\n│       └── History Section\\n└── Overlay (Settings/Games buttons, error dialogs)\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Dependencies\\n- &amp;#96;RightColumnCalculations&amp;#96; depends on &amp;#96;LeftColumnCalculations&amp;#96; for height matching\\n- &amp;#96;CombinedColumnView&amp;#96; uses &amp;#96;LeftColumnCalculations&amp;#96; for carousel heights\\n- Both views share the same &amp;#96;GeometryReader&amp;#96; context\\n\\n### Key Components to Modify\\n1. **MainView.swift** - Layout structure (HStack → ZStack)\\n2. **CombinedColumnView** - Width constraint (55% → 100%)\\n3. **RightColumnView** - Convert to drawer content\\n4. **New: DrawerView** - Drawer container with handle\\n5. **New: DrawerHandle** - Semi-transparent handle component\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Migration Strategy: Incremental &amp;amp; Safe\\n\\n### Phase 1: Foundation (Low Risk)\\n**Goal:** Set up drawer structure without breaking existing layout\\n\\n#### Step 1.1: Create Drawer State Management\\n- **File:** &amp;#96;MainView.swift&amp;#96;\\n- **Action:** Add &amp;#96;@State private var isDrawerOpen: Bool = false&amp;#96;\\n- **Risk:** None (new state, doesn't affect existing code)\\n- **Test:** Verify app still runs normally\\n\\n#### Step 1.2: Create DrawerHandle Component\\n- **File:** &amp;#96;Views/Components/DrawerHandle.swift&amp;#96; (new file)\\n- **Action:** Create reusable drawer handle view\\n- **Properties:**\\n  - Semi-transparent background (30-40% opacity)\\n  - Chevron icon (left-pointing when closed, right-pointing when open)\\n  - Rounded rectangle shape\\n  - Tap gesture to toggle drawer\\n  - Subtle pulse animation when closed\\n- **Risk:** None (new component, not integrated yet)\\n- **Test:** Can instantiate and display in preview\","

                  "lineNumber": 2308,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"6. ✅ **Phase 6** - Prompt modification (style in prompt)\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Key Design Decisions\\n\\n### Simplicity First\\n- Start with placeholder tiles (no images) - just visual proof\\n- Use style name in prompt (not reference image) initially\\n- Can add actual style reference images later\\n\\n### Backward Compatibility\\n- Default mode unchanged - all existing code paths work\\n- New mode is additive - doesn't break existing functionality\\n- View mode is opt-in via Settings\\n\\n### Incremental Testing\\n- Test each phase before moving to next\\n- Verify default mode still works after each change\\n- Test 4-carousel mode in isolation\\n\\n---\\n\\n## File Structure\\n\\n**New Files:**\\n- &amp;#96;Models/ViewMode.swift&amp;#96;\\n- &amp;#96;Views/Components/StylePlaceholderTile.swift&amp;#96;\\n- &amp;#96;Views/Components/FourCarouselView.swift&amp;#96;\\n\\n**Modified Files:**\\n- &amp;#96;ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift&amp;#96; - Style prompt handling (optional, Phase 6)\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Testing Checklist (Per Phase)\\n\\n**Phase 1:**\\n- [ ] View mode enum compiles\\n- [ ] View mode persists across app restarts\\n- [ ] Default mode still works\\n\\n**Phase 2:**\\n- [ ] Settings shows view mode selector\\n- [ ] Can switch between modes\\n- [ ] Main view updates when mode changes\\n\\n**Phase 3:**\\n- [ ] Style items load correctly\\n- [ ] Placeholder tiles render\\n- [ ] Can select style items\\n\\n**Phase 4:**\\n- [ ] FourCarouselView renders\\n- [ ] 4th carousel appears at bottom\\n- [ ] All 4 carousels are selectable\\n- [ ] Drawer still works\\n\\n**Phase 5:**\\n- [ ] Generation includes 4th reference when in 4-carousel mode\\n- [ ] Generation still works in default mode (3 images)\\n- [ ] Button state updates correctly\\n\\n**Phase 6:**\\n- [ ] Generated images reflect style selection\\n- [ ] Prompt includes style information\\n- [ ] Default mode prompts unchanged\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Risk Mitigation\\n\\n1. **Default Mode Must Work** - Always test default mode after each change\\n2. **Incremental Changes** - One phase at a time, test before proceeding\","

                  "lineNumber": 2614,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"| FindSpace | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | Medium | 4-6h | Medium* |\\n| enchantedforest | ⭐⭐⭐ | Medium | 8-10h | Low |\\n| Tracer3 | ⭐⭐⭐ | High | 12-16h | Low |\\n\\n*After fixing Phaser version\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Next Steps\\n\\n### Immediate Actions:\\n\\n1. **Choose First Game to Port**\\n   - Recommended: **goonpopper** (simplest, high appeal)\\n   - Or: **FindPrincess** (establishes Find game pattern)\\n\\n2. **Set Up Asset Structure**\\n   - Create server directories\\n   - Upload assets for chosen game\\n   - Test asset loading\\n\\n3. **Create Base Components**\\n   - &amp;#96;BaseMinigameViewModel&amp;#96;\\n   - &amp;#96;MinigameAssetService&amp;#96;\\n   - Shared timer/score components\\n\\n4. **Port First Game**\\n   - Follow Waypoint game pattern\\n   - Use SpriteKit for rendering\\n   - Implement game mechanics\\n   - Test on device\\n\\n### Long-term:\\n\\n5. **Port Remaining Games** (following priority order)\\n6. **Fix Broken Games** (if needed)\\n7. **Create Game Selection UI** (carousel/menu)\\n8. **Add Progress Tracking** (scores, completion)\\n9. **Add Achievements** (optional)\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Questions to Consider\\n\\n1. **Game Selection UI:** How should kids navigate between games?\\n   - Carousel (like current ingredient selection)?\\n   - Grid view?\\n   - World map (like enchantedforest)?\\n\\n2. **Progress Tracking:** Should games track:\\n   - High scores?\\n   - Completion status?\\n   - Time records?\\n\\n3. **Unlocking System:** Should games unlock progressively?\\n   - Or all available from start?\\n\\n4. **Audio:** For games with voice lines (Tracer3):\\n   - Include all audio?\\n   - Or simplify for iOS?\\n\\n---\\n\\n**Ready to start porting!** Recommend beginning with **goonpopper** or **FindPrincess** to establish patterns for the rest.\","

- Semi-transparent handle with chevron icon\\n- Created &amp;#96;DrawerView.swift&amp;#96; - Overlay drawer container with gestures\\n- Created &amp;#96;FloatingGenerationButton.swift&amp;#96; - Floating action button for generation\\n\\n### ✅ Phase 2: Layout Restructure\\n- Changed &amp;#96;MainView&amp;#96; from &amp;#96;HStack&amp;#96; to &amp;#96;ZStack&amp;#96;\\n- Carousels now full-width (100% instead of 55%)\\n- Removed width constraint on &amp;#96;CombinedColumnView&amp;#96;\\n\\n### ✅ Phase 3: Drawer Integration\\n- Integrated &amp;#96;RightColumnView&amp;#96;         "contents": "//\n//  MainViewModel.swift\n//  My First Swift\n//\n//  Created by Evan Robinson on 12/9/25.\n//\n\nimport Foundation\nimport SwiftUI\nimport Combine\n\nenum GenerationButtonState: Sendable {\n    case notReady\n    case ready\n    case generating\n    \n    var id: Int {\n        switch self {\n        case .notReady: return 0\n        case .ready: return 1\n        case .generating: return 2\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nclass MainViewModel: ObservableObject {\n    private let apiClient = APIClient.shared\n    private let sseService = SSEService.shared\n    private let assetsService = AssetsService.shared\n    private var cancellables = Set&lt;AnyCancellable&gt;()\n    private var imageGenerationTask: Task&lt;Void, Never&gt;?\n    \n    // View mode - controls which layout is displayed\n    @Published var viewMode: ViewMode = .default {\n        didSet {\n            // Persist view mode selection\n            UserDefaults.standard.set(viewMode.rawValue, forKey: \"viewMode\")\n            // Load style items when switching to fourCarousel mode\n            if viewMode == .fourCarousel &amp;&amp; styleItems.isEmpty {\n                loadStyleItems()\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Carousel indices\n    @Published var friendIndex = -1\n    @Published var outfitIndex = -1\n    @Published var placeIndex = -1\n    @Published var styleIndex = -1 // For 4th carousel (style/medium)\n    \n    // Ingredients by category (filtered from API)\n    @Published var friendItems: [Ingredient] = []\n    @Published var outfitItems: [Ingredient] = []\n    @Published var placeItems: [Ingredient] = []\n    @Published var styleItems: [Ingredient] = [] // Placeholder style items\n    \n    // Preview and history\n    @Published var previewImage: UIImage?\n    @Published var historyImages: [GeneratedImage] = []\n    \n    // Background image\n    @Published var backgroundImage: UIImage?\n    \n    // Button state\n    @Published var buttonState: GenerationButtonState = .notReady\n    \n    // Loading states\n    @Published var isLoadingIngredients = false\n    @Published var isLoadingHistory = false\n    @Published var isCreatingImage = false",

        "contents": "class AssetsService: ObservableObject {\n    static let shared = AssetsService()\n    \n    private let apiClient = APIClient.shared\n    private var cancellables = Set&lt;AnyCancellable&gt;()\n    \n    @Published var isLoading = false\n    @Published var errorMessage: String?\n    \n    // Cached assets by type\n    @Published var assetsByType: [String: [Asset]] = [:]\n    \n    init() {\n        // Load assets on initialization\n        loadAllAssets()\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Public Methods\n    \n    /// Get all available asset types\n    func getAssetTypes() -&gt; AnyPublisher&lt;[String], Error&gt; {\n        guard let url = URL(string: \"\\(apiClient.baseURL)/api/assets/types\") else {\n            return Fail(error: URLError(.badURL))\n                .eraseToAnyPublisher()\n        }\n        \n        var request = URLRequest(url: url)\n        request.httpMethod = \"GET\"\n        ServerConfig.shared.addAPIKeyHeader(to: &amp;request)\n        \n        return URLSession.shared.dataTaskPublisher(for: request)\n            .map(\\.data)\n            .decode(type: AssetTypesResponse.self, decoder: JSONDecoder())\n            .map { $0.types }\n            .eraseToAnyPublisher()\n    }\n    \n    /// Get all assets organized by type\n    func getAllAssets() -&gt; AnyPublisher&lt;[Asset], Error&gt; {\n        // URL encode the type (handles nested types like \"ui/icons\")",

        "contents": "    /// These are placeholder ingredients with no actual images - style will be passed as text description\n    /// Each style has a display name (for UI) and a detailed prompt (for GPT)\n    private func loadStyleItems() {\n        // Style definitions: (displayName, idSuffix, detailedPrompt)\n        // The detailed prompt is what gets sent to GPT for better style application\n        // Comprehensive collection of diverse artistic styles, media, movements, and moods\n        let styles: [(String, String, String)] = [\n            // Traditional Drawing Media\n            (\"Crayon\", \"crayon\", \"Crayon drawing with bold, vibrant colors, childlike simplicity, and visible texture from the waxy medium\"),\n            (\"Charcoal\", \"charcoal\", \"Charcoal sketch with rich blacks, soft grays, smudged edges, and dramatic contrast\"),\n            (\"Pencil\", \"pencil\", \"Pencil sketch with fine lines, cross-hatching, detailed shading, and graphite texture\"),\n            (\"Ink Wash\", \"ink_wash\", \"Ink wash painting with flowing brushstrokes, varying opacity, and elegant simplicity\"),\n            (\"Pen &amp; Ink\", \"pen_ink\", \"Pen and ink illustration with precise lines, stippling, and intricate detail\"),\n            (\"Pastel\", \"pastel\", \"Soft pastel drawing with velvety texture, vibrant colors, and delicate blending\"),\n            (\"Chalk\", \"chalk\", \"Chalk drawing with powdery texture, vibrant colors, and soft, blendable strokes\"),\n            (\"Marker\", \"marker\", \"Marker illustration with bold, saturated colors, clean lines, and graphic style\"),\n            \n            // Traditional Painting Media\n            (\"Watercolor\", \"watercolor\", \"Watercolor painting with soft, flowing colors, translucent washes, and organic blending\"),\n            (\"Oil Painting\", \"oil_painting\", \"Oil painting with rich, saturated colors, visible brushstrokes, and classical painting technique\"),\n            (\"Acrylic\", \"acrylic\", \"Acrylic painting with bold, opaque colors, thick impasto texture, and modern vibrancy\"),\n            (\"Gouache\", \"gouache\", \"Gouache painting with matte finish, opaque colors, and smooth, flat application\"),\n            (\"Tempera\", \"tempera\", \"Tempera painting with egg-based medium, bright colors, and fine detail\"),\n            (\"Fresco\", \"fresco\", \"Fresco painting with earthy tones, wall texture, and classical mural technique\"),\n            \n            // Digital &amp; Modern Media\n            (\"Pixel Art\", \"pixel_art\", \"Pixel art with blocky, retro aesthetic, limited color palette, and 8-bit charm\"),\n            (\"Vector Art\", \"vector_art\", \"Vector illustration with clean lines, flat colors, and scalable graphic design\"),\n            (\"3D Render\", \"3d_render\", \"3D rendered image with realistic lighting, depth, and computer-generated precision\"),\n            (\"Digital Painting\", \"digital_painting\", \"Digital painting with smooth blending, vibrant colors, and modern artistic technique\"),\n            (\"Glitch Art\", \"glitch_art\", \"Glitch art with digital artifacts, color shifts, and intentional data corruption aesthetic\"),\n            (\"Holographic\", \"holographic\", \"Holographic effect with iridescent colors, rainbow shimmer, and futuristic appearance\"),\n            \n            // Artistic Movements &amp;         "contents": "    \n    private func showToast(\n        _ message: String,\n        type: ToastView.ToastType = .info,\n        duration: TimeInterval = 3.0,\n        customColor: Color? = nil,\n        customIcon: String? = nil,\n        imageURL: String? = nil,\n        position: ToastView.ToastPosition = .top\n    ) {\n        toastMessage = ToastMessage(\n            message: message,\n            type: type,\n            duration: duration,\n            customColor: customColor,\n            customIcon: customIcon,\n            imageURL: imageURL,\n            position: position\n        )\n    }\n    \n    private func loadBackgroundFromURL(_ urlString: String) {\n        let baseURL = apiClient.baseURL\n        let fullURL: String\n        \n        if urlString.hasPrefix(\"http\") {\n            fullURL = urlString\n        } else if urlString.hasPrefix(\"/\") {\n            fullURL = \"\\(baseURL)\\(urlString)\"\n        } else {\n            fullURL = \"\\(baseURL)/\\(urlString)\"\n        }\n        \n        guard let url = URL(string: fullURL) else {\n            print(\"⚠️ MainViewModel: Invalid background URL: \\(fullURL)\")\n            return\n        }\n        \n        Task {\n            do {\n                if let image = try await ImageCache.shared.loadImage(from: url) {\n                    await MainActor.run {\n                        self.backgroundImage = image\n                    }\n                }\n            } catch {\n                print(\"❌ MainViewModel: Error loading background from \\(fullURL): \\(error)\")\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    func loadData() {\n        loadBackgroundImage()\n        loadIngredients()\n        loadHistory()\n        \n        // Connect to SSE event stream\n        sseService.connect()\n    }\n    \n    private func loadBackgroundImage() {\n        // Use Combine to get backgrounds from Assets API",

Atmospheres\n            (\"Dreamy\", \"dreamy\", \"Dreamy atmosphere with soft focus, pastel colors, and ethereal quality\"),\n            (\"Dramatic\", \"dramatic\", \"Dramatic lighting with high contrast, shadows, and cinematic intensity\"),\n            (\"Ethereal\", \"ethereal\", \"Ethereal quality with glowing light, translucent forms, and otherworldly beauty\"),\n            (\"Nostalgic\", \"nostalgic\", \"Nostalgic mood with warm tones, vintage aesthetic, and sentimental atmosphere\"),\n            (\"Whimsical\", \"whimsical\", \"Whimsical style with playful elements, bright colors, and lighthearted charm\"),\n            (\"Mysterious\", \"mysterious\", \"Mysterious atmosphere with dark tones, shadows, and enigmatic mood\"),\n            (\"Serene\", \"serene\", \"Serene mood with calm colors, peaceful composition, and tranquil atmosphere\"),\n            (\"Energetic\", \"energetic\", \"Energetic style with dynamic movement, vibrant colors, and lively composition\"),\n            \n            // Blended &amp;         "contents": "    // MARK: - Playlist Loading\n    \n    func loadPlaylist() {\n        // Check cache first\n        if let cachedPlaylist = loadCachedPlaylist(), isCacheFresh() {\n            print(\"✅ MusicService: Using cached playlist (\\(cachedPlaylist.count) songs)\")\n            playlist = cachedPlaylist\n            restorePlaybackState()\n            return\n        }\n        \n        // Fetch from server\n        isLoading = true\n        assetsService.getAssets(type: \"music\")\n            .receive(on: DispatchQueue.main)\n            .sink(\n                receiveCompletion: { [weak self] completion in\n                    self?.isLoading = false\n                    if case .failure(let error) = completion {\n                        print(\"❌ MusicService: Error loading playlist: \\(error)\")\n                        // Try to use stale cache if available\n                        if let cached = self?.loadCachedPlaylist() {\n                            print(\"⚠️ MusicService: Using stale cached playlist\")\n                            self?.playlist = cached\n                        }\n                    }\n                },\n                receiveValue: { [weak self] assets in\n                    guard let self = self else { return }\n                    let tracks = assets.map { MusicTrack(from: $0) }\n                    self.playlist = tracks\n                    self.cachePlaylist(tracks)\n                    print(\"✅ MusicService: Loaded \\(tracks.count) songs from server\")\n                    \n                    // Auto-start if music is enabled\n                    if self.isMusicEnabled &amp;&amp; !self.isPlaying &amp;&amp; !tracks.isEmpty {\n                        self.play()\n                    }\n                }\n            )\n            .store(in: &amp;cancellables)\n    }\n    \n    private func loadCachedPlaylist() -&gt; [MusicTrack]? {\n        guard let data = UserDefaults.standard.data(forKey: playlistCacheKey),\n              ",

        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./abbies.world.ios/abbies.world.ios/Services/AssetsService.swift",

        },
        "contents": "    /// Get assets of a specific type\n    func getAssets(type: String) -&gt; AnyPublisher&lt;[Asset], Error&gt; {\n        // URL encode the type (handles nested types like \"ui/icons\")\n        guard let encodedType = type.addingPercentEncoding(withAllowedCharacters: .urlPathAllowed),\n              let url = URL(string: \"\\(apiClient.baseURL)/api/assets/\\(encodedType)\") else {\n            return Fail(error: URLError(.badURL))\n                .eraseToAnyPublisher()\n        }\n        \n        var request = URLRequest(url: url)\n        request.httpMethod = \"GET\"\n        ServerConfig.shared.addAPIKeyHeader(to: &amp;request)\n        \n        return URLSession.shared.dataTaskPublisher(for: request)\n            .map(\\.data)\n            .decode(type: AssetsByTypeResponse.self, decoder: JSONDecoder())\n            .map { $0.assets }\n            .eraseToAnyPublisher()\n    }\n    \n    /// Get metadata for a specific asset\n    func getAssetMetadata(type: String, name: String) -&gt; AnyPublisher&lt;Asset, Error&gt; {\n        guard let encodedType = type.addingPercentEncoding(withAllowedCharacters: .urlPathAllowed),\n              let encodedName = name.addingPercentEncoding(withAllowedCharacters: .urlPathAllowed),\n              let url = URL(string: \"\\(apiClient.baseURL)/api/assets/\\(encodedType)/\\(encodedName)\") else {\n            return Fail(error: URLError(.badURL))\n                .eraseToAnyPublisher()\n        }\n        \n        var request = URLRequest(url: url)\n        request.httpMethod = \"GET\"\n        ServerConfig.shared.addAPIKeyHeader(to: &amp;request)\n        \n        return URLSession.shared.dataTaskPublisher(for: request)\n            .map(\\.data)\n            .decode(type: Asset.self, decoder: JSONDecoder())\n            .eraseToAnyPublisher()\n    }\n    \n    /// Build full URL for an asset\n    func assetURL(for asset: Asset) -&gt; URL? {\n        // Asset.url is already a path like \"/static/assets/friends/01_star_puppy.png\"\n        return URL(string: \"\\(apiClient.baseURL)\\(asset.url)\")\n    }\n    \n    /// Build full URL from type and name\n    func assetURL(type: String, name: String) -&gt; URL? {\n        return URL(string: \"\\(apiClient.baseURL)/static/assets/\\(type.addingPercentEncoding(withAllowedCharacters: .urlPathAllowed) ?? type)/\\(name.addingPercentEncoding(withAllowedCharacters: .urlPathAllowed) ?? name)\")",

        "contents": "//\n//  CarouselView.swift\n//  My First Swift\n//\n//  Created by Evan Robinson on 12/9/25.\n//  Updated to use SwiftCarousel library\n//\n\nimport SwiftUI\n\nstruct CarouselView: View {\n    let title: String\n    let items: [Ingredient]\n    @Binding var selectedIndex: Int\n    let onItemSelected: (Ingredient) -&gt; Void\n    \n    // TEMPORARY: Optional mapping for style short descriptions\n    // Remove this parameter when we have actual style assets\n    var styleShortDescriptions: [String: String]? = nil\n    \n    // Optional custom tile size (for 4-carousel view to fit on screen)\n    var customTileSize: CGFloat? = nil\n    \n    // Convert Ingredient to CarouselItem for SwiftCarousel\n    private var carouselItems: [CarouselItem] {\n        return items.map { ingredient in\n            // TEMPORARY: For style items (art_style category), include short description\n            // This is for placeholder tile overlays until we have actual assets\n            // Remove the shortDescription parameter when assets are available\n            let shortDesc: String? = (ingredient.category == \"art_style\") \n                ? styleShortDescriptions?[ingredient.id] \n                : nil\n            \n            return CarouselItem(\n                id: ingredient.id,\n                imageURL: ingredient.imageURL,\n                displayName: ingredient.name,\n                shortDescription: shortDesc\n            )\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Binding for SwiftCarousel (uses Int? instead of Int)\n    private var selectedIndexBinding: Binding&lt;Int?&gt; {\n        Binding(\n            get: { selectedIndex &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; selectedIndex &lt; items.count ? selectedIndex : nil },\n            set: { newValue in\n                if let newValue = newValue, newValue &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; newValue &lt; items.count {\n                    selectedIndex = newValue\n                } else {\n                    selectedIndex = -1\n                }\n            }\n        )\n    }\n    \n    // Carousel configuration - larger tiles for expanded rows\n    // Use custom size if provided (for 4-carousel view), otherwise default to 280\n    private var carouselConfig: CarouselConfig {\n        ",

        "contents": "//\n//  WaypointGameViewModel.swift\n//  My First Swift\n//\n//  Created for Waypoint Navigation Minigame\n//\n\nimport Foundation\nimport SwiftUI\nimport Combine\nimport UIKit\n\nclass WaypointGameViewModel: ObservableObject {\n    @Published var gameState = WaypointGameState()\n    \n    private var cancellables = Set&lt;AnyCancellable&gt;()\n    private var buggyAnimationTimer: Timer?\n    private var pulseTimer: Timer?\n    let audioService = WaypointGameAudioService()\n    \n    // Asset base URL - uses centralized ServerConfig\n    // Uses Assets API route for nested directory structure\n    private var assetBaseURL: String {\n        let base = ServerConfig.shared.baseURL\n        return \"\\(base)/static/assets/minigames/waypoint\"\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Initialization\n    \n    init() {\n        loadDefaultWaypoints()\n        setupPulseAnimation()\n    }\n    \n    deinit {\n        buggyAnimationTimer?.invalidate()\n        pulseTimer?.invalidate()\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Game Setup\n    \n    func loadDefaultWaypoints() {\n        gameState.waypoints = WaypointGameState.defaultWaypoints()\n        \n        // Build good nodes order\n        let goodNodes = gameState.waypoints.filter { $0.isTraversable }\n        gameState.totalGoodNodes = goodNodes.count\n        gameState.goodNodesOrder = gameState.waypoints\n            .enumerated()\n            .filter { $0.element.isTraversable }\n            .map { $0.offset }\n        gameState.currentGoodNodeIndex = 0\n        \n        updateStatusMessage()\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Asset Loading\n    \n    func loadAssets() async {\n        print(\"🎮 Starting asset loading...\")\n        print(\"📍 Asset base URL: \\(assetBaseURL)\")\n        await loadCriticalAssets()\n        // Pre-load victory assets in background\n        Task {\n            await loadVictoryAssets()\n        }\n        // Start background music\n        audioService.playBackgroundMusic()\n    }\n    \n    private func loadCriticalAssets() async {\n        // Load buggy sprite\n        let buggyURLString = \"\\(assetBaseURL)/moon_buggy_sprite.png\"",

        "contents": "    func assetURL(type: String, name: String) -&gt; URL? {\n        return URL(string: \"\\(apiClient.baseURL)/static/assets/\\(type.addingPercentEncoding(withAllowedCharacters: .urlPathAllowed) ?? type)/\\(name.addingPercentEncoding(withAllowedCharacters: .urlPathAllowed) ?? name)\")\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Convenience Methods\n    \n    /// Load all assets and cache them\n    func loadAllAssets() {\n        isLoading = true\n        errorMessage = nil\n        \n        getAllAssets()\n            .receive(on: DispatchQueue.main)\n            .sink(\n                receiveCompletion: { [weak self] completion in\n                    self?.isLoading = false\n                    if case .failure(let error) = completion {\n                        self?.errorMessage = \"Failed to load assets: \\(error.localizedDescription)\"\n                        print(\"❌ AssetsService: Error loading assets: \\(error)\")\n                    }\n                },\n                receiveValue: { [weak self] assets in\n                    self?.assetsByType = assets\n                    let total = assets.values.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.count }\n                    print(\"✅ AssetsService: Loaded \\(total) assets across \\(assets.count) types\")\n                }\n            )\n            .store(in: &amp;cancellables)\n    }\n    \n    /// Get cached assets for a type, or load if not cached\n    func getAssetsForType(_ type: String) -&gt; [Asset] {\n        return assetsByType[type] ?? []\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "        .onChange(of: selectedIngredient) { oldValue, newValue in\n            loadImage(for: newValue)\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func loadImage(for ingredient: Ingredient?) {\n        guard let ingredient = ingredient,\n              let imageURLString = ingredient.imageURL,\n              let url = URL(string: imageURLString) else {\n            slotImage = nil\n            return\n        }\n        \n        // Check cache first\n        if let cachedImage = ImageCache.shared.getCachedImage(for: url) {\n            self.slotImage = cachedImage\n            return\n        }\n        \n        // Load from network\n        isLoadingImage = true\n        Task {\n            do {\n                if let loadedImage = try await ImageCache.shared.loadImage(from: url) {\n                    await MainActor.run {\n                        self.slotImage = loadedImage\n                        self.isLoadingImage = false\n                    }\n                } else {\n                    await MainActor.run {\n                        self.isLoadingImage = false\n                    }\n                }\n            } catch {\n                await MainActor.run {\n                    self.isLoadingImage = false\n                }\n                print(\"Error loading slot image for \\(ingredient.name): \\(error)\")\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "#!/bin/bash\n\n# Script to enumerate waypoint navigation game assets on the server\n# Uses the Assets API to discover available files\n\n# Don't exit on error - we want to check all files\nset +e\n\n# Configuration\nBASE_URL=\"${BASE_URL:-http://abbies.world:8000}\"\nAPI_KEY=\"${ABBIES_WORLD_SERVER_API_KEY:-[REDACTED_REVOKED_KEY]}\"\n\n# Colors for output\nGREEN='\\033[0;32m'\nYELLOW='\\033[1;33m'\nRED='\\033[0;31m'\nBLUE='\\033[0;34m'\nNC='\\033[0m' # No Color\n\necho -e \"${BLUE}=== Waypoint Navigation Game Asset Enumerator ===${NC}\"\necho -e \"Server: ${BASE_URL}\"\necho -e \"API Key: ${API_KEY:0:10}...${NC}\\n\"\n\n# Function to make API request\napi_request() {\n    local endpoint=\"$1\"\n    local url=\"${BASE_URL}${endpoint}\"\n    \n    curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer ${API_KEY}\" \\\n         -H \"Accept: application/json\" \\\n         \"$url\"\n}\n\n# Function to check if a file exists via direct static path\ncheck_static_file() {\n    local filepath=\"$1\"\n    local url=\"${BASE_URL}/static/assets/minigames/waypoint/${filepath}\"\n    \n    # URL encode spaces in filename\n    local encoded_url=$(echo \"$url\" | sed 's/ /%20/g')\n    \n    local status=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\" \\\n                      -H \"Authorization: Bearer ${API_KEY}\" \\\n                      \"$encoded_url\" 2&gt;/dev/null)\n    \n    if [ \"$status\" = \"200\" ]; then\n        echo -e \"${GREEN}✓${NC}\"\n        return 0\n    elif [ \"$status\" = \"000\" ]; then\n        echo -e \"${RED}✗ (Connection failed)${NC}\"\n        return 1\n    else\n        echo -e \"${RED}✗ (HTTP $status)${NC}\"\n        return 1\n    fi\n}\n\necho -e \"${BLUE}1. Checking Assets API endpoints...${NC}\\n\"\n\n# Check if Assets API is available\necho -n \"  Testing /api/assets/types... \"\ntypes_response=$(api_request \"/api/assets/types\")\nif echo \"$types_response\" | grep -q \"types\"; then\n    echo -e \"${GREEN}✓${NC}\"\n    echo \"$types_response\" | python3 -m json.tool 2&gt;/dev/null || echo \"$types_response\"\nelse\n    echo -e \"${RED}✗${NC}\"\n    echo \"  Response: $types_response\"\nfi",

        "contents": "    /// Priority: UserDefaults &gt; Info.plist &gt; Environment variable &gt; nil\n    var apiKey: String? {\n        // 1. Check UserDefaults first (runtime override)\n        if let userDefaultsKey = UserDefaults.standard.string(forKey: \"ServerAPIKey\"), !userDefaultsKey.isEmpty {\n            return userDefaultsKey\n        }\n        \n        // 2. Check Info.plist (build-time configuration)\n        if let infoPlistKey = Bundle.main.object(forInfoDictionaryKey: \"ServerAPIKey\") as? String, !infoPlistKey.isEmpty {\n            return infoPlistKey\n        }\n        \n        // 3. Check environment variable (for development)\n        if let envKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment[\"ABBIES_WORLD_SERVER_API_KEY\"], !envKey.isEmpty {\n            return envKey\n        }\n        \n        // 4. No API key found\n        print(\"⚠️ ServerConfig: No API key found\")\n        return nil\n    }\n    \n    /// Set API key at runtime (stores in UserDefaults)\n    func setAPIKey(_ key: String) {\n        UserDefaults.standard.set(key, forKey: \"ServerAPIKey\")\n        UserDefaults.standard.synchronize()\n    }\n    \n    /// Reset API key to default (removes UserDefaults override)\n    func resetAPIKey() {\n        UserDefaults.standard.removeObject(forKey: \"ServerAPIKey\")\n        UserDefaults.standard.synchronize()\n    }\n    \n    /// Add API key header to a URLRequest if available\n    /// Uses Authorization header with Bearer format: \"Bearer {key}\"\n    func addAPIKeyHeader(to request: inout URLRequest) {\n        if let apiKey = apiKey {\n            request.setValue(\"Bearer \\(apiKey)\", forHTTPHeaderField: \"Authorization\")\n        } else {\n            print(\"⚠️ ServerConfig: No API key available\")\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private init() {\n        // Private initializer for singleton\n    }\n}",

## Summary

The game automatically enumerates carousel tiles from server data. There is no artificial limit for the main game carousels (friends, outfits, places, styles).

## Data Flow

1. **MainViewModel.loadCarouselItems()** (lines 377-443):
   - Calls `assetsService.getAssets(type: "friends")`, `getAssets(type: "outfits")`, and `getAssets(type: "places")`
   - Assigns all returned assets directly:
     - `self.friendItems = ingredients` (line 397)
     - `self.outfitItems = ingredients` (line 418)
     - `self.placeItems = ingredients` (line 439)
   - No limiting applied

2. **createIngredientsFromAssets()** (lines 445-458):
   - Maps all assets: `return assets.map { asset -> Ingredient in ... }`
   - No filtering or limiting

3. **AssetsService.getAssets()** (lines 118-135):
   - Fetches from `/api/assets/{type}` and returns all assets: `.map { $0.assets }`
   - No client-side limiting

4. **CarouselView** (lines 25-41):
   - Maps all items: `return items.map { ingredient in ... }`
   - No limiting

5. **Carousel component** (Carousel.swift, line 24):
   - Renders all items: `ForEach(Array(items.enumerated()), id: \.element.id)`
   - No limiting

## Exception

The only limit found is in `MainView.swift` line 381 for the history carousel:
```swift
historyImages.prefix(20).map { image in ...
```
This limits history images to 20, but it does not affect the main game carousels.

## Conclusion

The main game carousels (friends, outfits, places, styles) display all items returned by the server with no artificial limits. The number of tiles is determined by the server response.

        "contents": "    // Use custom size if provided (for 4-carousel view), otherwise default to 280\n    private var carouselConfig: CarouselConfig {\n        var config = CarouselConfig.default()\n        let tileSize = customTileSize ?? 280 // Default 280, smaller for 4-carousel view\n        config.tileWidth = tileSize\n        config.tileHeight = tileSize\n        config.tileSpacing = 16\n        config.horizontalPadding = 20\n        return config\n    }\n    \n    var body: some View {\n            // Use SwiftCarousel for horizontal scrolling\n            Carousel(\n                items: carouselItems,\n                selectedIndex: selectedIndexBinding,\n                config: carouselConfig,\n                onSelect: { carouselItem in\n                    // Find the corresponding Ingredient and call the callback\n                    if let index = items.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == carouselItem.id }) {\n                        selectedIndex = index\n                        onItemSelected(items[index])\n                    }\n                }\n            )\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "//\n//  Carousel.swift\n//  SwiftCarousel\n//\n//  Created by Evan Robinson on 12/11/25.\n//\n\nimport SwiftUI\n\nstruct Carousel: View {\n    let items: [CarouselItem]\n    @Binding var selectedIndex: Int?\n    let config: CarouselConfig\n    var onSelect: ((CarouselItem) -&gt; Void)? = nil\n    \n    var body: some View {\n        ScrollView(.horizontal, showsIndicators: false) {\n            HStack(spacing: config.tileSpacing) {\n                // Leading padding\n                Spacer()\n                    .frame(width: config.horizontalPadding)\n                \n                // Tiles\n                ForEach(Array(items.enumerated()), id: \\.element.id) { index, item in\n                    Button(action: {\n                        handleTap(at: index, item: item)\n                    }) {\n                        TileView(\n                            item: item,\n                            config: config,\n                            isSelected: selectedIndex == index\n                        )\n                    }\n                    .buttonStyle(PlainButtonStyle())\n                }\n                \n                // Trailing padding\n                Spacer()\n                    .frame(width: config.horizontalPadding)\n            }\n            .padding(.vertical, calculateVerticalPaddingForScale())\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func handleTap(at index: Int, item: CarouselItem) {\n        // If tapping the already selected item, deselect it\n        if selectedIndex == index {\n            selectedIndex = nil\n            return\n        }\n        \n        // Update selection\n        selectedIndex = index\n        onSelect?(item)\n    }\n    \n    // Calculate vertical padding needed inside ScrollView to prevent clipping\n    private func calculateVerticalPaddingForScale() -&gt; CGFloat {\n        // Scale grows from center, so growth in each direction = (scale - 1) * height / 2",

        "contents": "//\n//  CarouselView.swift\n//  My First Swift\n//\n//  Created by Evan Robinson on 12/9/25.\n//  Updated to use SwiftCarousel library\n//\n\nimport SwiftUI\n\nstruct CarouselView: View {\n    let title: String\n    let items: [Ingredient]\n    @Binding var selectedIndex: Int\n    let onItemSelected: (Ingredient) -&gt; Void\n    \n    // TEMPORARY: Optional mapping for style short descriptions\n    // Remove this parameter when we have actual style assets\n    var styleShortDescriptions: [String: String]? = nil\n    \n    // Optional custom tile size (for 4-carousel view to fit on screen)\n    var customTileSize: CGFloat? = nil\n    \n    // Convert Ingredient to CarouselItem for SwiftCarousel\n    private var carouselItems: [CarouselItem] {\n        return items.map { ingredient in\n            // TEMPORARY: For style items (art_style category), include short description\n            // This is for placeholder tile overlays until we have actual assets\n            // Remove the shortDescription parameter when assets are available\n            let shortDesc: String? = (ingredient.category == \"art_style\") \n                ? styleShortDescriptions?[ingredient.id] \n                : nil\n            \n            return CarouselItem(\n                id: ingredient.id,\n                imageURL: ingredient.imageURL,\n                displayName: ingredient.name,\n                shortDescription: shortDesc\n            )\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Binding for SwiftCarousel (uses Int? instead of Int)\n    private var selectedIndexBinding: Binding&lt;Int?&gt; {\n        Binding(\n            get: { selectedIndex &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; selectedIndex &lt; items.count ? selectedIndex : nil },\n            set: { newValue in\n                if let newValue = newValue, newValue &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; newValue &lt; items.count {\n                    selectedIndex = newValue\n                } else {\n                    selectedIndex = -1\n                }\n            }\n        )\n    }\n    \n    // Carousel configuration - larger tiles for expanded rows\n    // Use custom size if provided (for 4-carousel view), otherwise default to 280\n    private var carouselConfig: CarouselConfig {\n        ",

        "contents": "    private func startAutoAdvance() {\n        autoAdvanceTimer?.invalidate()\n        autoAdvanceTimer = Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval: 5.0, repeats: true) { _ in\n            guard !self.viewModel.gameState.isGridView else {\n                self.autoAdvanceTimer?.invalidate()\n                return\n            }\n            self.advancePolaroid()\n        }\n        \n        // Auto-show grid view after 2 full cycles\n        let cycleTime = Double(viewModel.gameState.polaroidImages.count) * 5.0\n        gridViewTimer = Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval: cycleTime * 2, repeats: false) { _ in\n            guard !self.viewModel.gameState.isGridView else { return }\n            self.showGridView()\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func showCarouselHint() {\n        withAnimation(.easeIn(duration: 0.5)) {\n            carouselHintOpacity = 1.0\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func advancePolaroid() {\n        viewModel.gameState.currentPolaroidIndex = (viewModel.gameState.currentPolaroidIndex + 1) % viewModel.gameState.polaroidImages.count\n        viewModel.gameState.polaroidClicks += 1\n        \n        // Reset auto-advance timer\n        autoAdvanceTimer?.invalidate()\n        startAutoAdvance()\n        \n        // Show \"View All\" button after 3 clicks or after viewing all photos once\n        if viewModel.gameState.polaroidClicks &gt;= 3 || (viewModel.gameState.currentPolaroidIndex == 0 &amp;&amp; viewModel.gameState.polaroidClicks &gt; 0) {\n            if !showViewAllButton {\n                withAnimation {\n                    showViewAllButton = true\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func showGridView() {\n        autoAdvanceTimer?.invalidate()",

  // Start victory music\n            viewModel.audioService.startVictoryMusic()\n            \n            // Start polaroid entrance sequence\n            startPolaroidEntrance()\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func startPolaroidEntrance() {\n        let polaroidCount = viewModel.gameState.polaroidImages.count\n        print(\"🎉 VictorySequenceView: Starting polaroid entrance with         startAutoAdvance()\n            showCarouselHint()\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func startAutoAdvance() {\n        autoAdvanceTimer?.invalidate()",

        "contents": "//\n//  CarouselItem.swift\n//  SwiftCarousel\n//\n//  Created by Evan Robinson on 12/11/25.\n//\n\nimport SwiftUI\n\nstruct CarouselItem: Identifiable {\n    let id: String\n    let imageName: String?      // Optional: for bundle-based images\n    let imageURL: String?       // Optional: for URL-based images\n    let displayName: String\n    let shortDescription: String? // Optional: short description (1-4 words) for placeholder tiles\n    \n    // Convenience initializer for bundle-based images (backward compatible)\n    init(id: String, imageName: String, displayName: String, shortDescription: String? = nil) {\n        self.id = id\n        self.imageName = imageName\n        self.imageURL = nil\n        self.displayName = displayName\n        self.shortDescription = shortDescription\n    }\n    \n    // Initializer for URL-based images\n    init(id: String, imageURL: String, displayName: String, shortDescription: String? = nil) {\n        self.id = id\n        self.imageName = nil\n        self.imageURL = imageURL\n        self.displayName = displayName\n        self.shortDescription = shortDescription\n    }\n    \n    // Full initializer for both (URL takes precedence)\n    init(id: String, imageName: String? = nil, imageURL: String? = nil, displayName: String, shortDescription: String? = nil) {\n        self.id = id\n        self.imageName = imageName\n        self.imageURL = imageURL\n        self.displayName = displayName\n        self.shortDescription = shortDescription\n    }\n    \n    static func sampleItems(count: Int = 15) -&gt; [CarouselItem] {\n        let imageNames = [\n            \"01_star_puppy\",\n            \"02_star_kitten\",",

        "contents": "# View Mode System - Implementation Plan\n\n## Overview\nAdd a view mode selection system that allows switching between different main view layouts. Start with DEFAULT (current) and add a new 4-CAROUSEL mode with style selection.\n\n## Acceptance Criteria\n1. ✅ Default view works unchanged\n2. ✅ View mode selectable from Settings menu\n3. ✅ 4th carousel bottom-aligned with preview drawer\n4. ✅ 4th reference image included in generation when in 4-carousel mode\n5. ✅ GPT prompt modified to use style input\n\n---\n\n## Step-by-Step Implementation Plan\n\n### Phase 1: View Mode Infrastructure (Foundation)\n\n#### Step 1.1: Create View Mode Enum\n**File:** &#96;Models/ViewMode.swift&#96; (NEW)\n- Enum: &#96;ViewMode&#96; with cases:\n  - &#96;.default&#96; (current 3-carousel view)\n  - &#96;.fourCarousel&#96; (new 4-carousel view)\n- Make it &#96;Codable&#96; for persistence\n- Add &#96;displayName: String&#96; computed property\n\n#### Step 1.2: Add View Mode State to MainViewModel\n**File:** &#96;ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift&#96;\n- Add &#96;@Published var viewMode: ViewMode = .default&#96;\n- Add &#96;@Published var styleIndex: Int = -1&#96; (for 4th carousel)\n- Add &#96;@Published var styleItems: [Ingredient] = []&#96; (placeholder styles)\n- Update &#96;allSelectionsReady&#96; computed property:\n  - Default mode: requires friend, outfit, place (3 selections)\n  - FourCarousel mode: requires friend, outfit, place, style (4 selections)\n\n#### Step 1.3: Persist View Mode Selection\n**File:** &#96;ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift&#96;\n- Save &#96;viewMode&#96; to UserDefaults on change\n- Load &#96;viewMode&#96; from UserDefaults in &#96;init()&#96;\n- Add &#96;func setViewMode(_ mode: ViewMode)&#96; method\n\n---\n\n### Phase 2: Settings UI (View Selection)\n\n#### Step 2.1: Add View Mode Selector to Settings\n**File:** &#96;Views/Components/SettingsView.swift&#96;\n- Add new section: \"View Mode\" above Music Controls\n- Add &#96;@ObservedObject var viewModel: MainViewModel&#96; parameter\n- Create &#96;ViewModeSelector&#96; component:\n  - Shows current view mode",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "- Create &#96;ViewModeSelector&#96; component:\n  - Shows current view mode\n  - Picker/segmented control to switch modes\n  - Options: \"Default\" and \"4 Carousels\" (or \"Style Mode\")\n\n**Note:** SettingsView needs access to MainViewModel. Pass it as parameter.\n\n---\n\n### Phase 3: Style Carousel Data (Placeholder Tiles)\n\n#### Step 3.1: Create Placeholder Style Ingredients\n**File:** &#96;ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift&#96;\n- Add method &#96;loadStyleItems()&#96; that creates 5 placeholder &#96;Ingredient&#96; objects:\n  - IDs: &#96;style_crayon&#96;, &#96;style_charcoal&#96;, &#96;style_pencil&#96;, &#96;style_watercolor&#96;, &#96;style_oil_painting&#96;\n  - Names: \"Crayon\", \"Charcoal\", \"Pencil\", \"Watercolor\", \"Oil Painting\"\n  - Category: \"art_style\"\n  - &#96;imageURL: nil&#96; (will use placeholder tile)\n- Call this in &#96;init()&#96; or when view mode changes to &#96;.fourCarousel&#96;\n\n#### Step 3.2: Create Placeholder Tile View\n**File:** &#96;Views/Components/StylePlaceholderTile.swift&#96; (NEW)\n- Simple SwiftUI view that renders:\n  - Dark blue background\n  - Light blue architectural/geometric lines\n  - Style name text overlay\n- Make it look \"cool\" but simple\n- Size: Match existing carousel tile dimensions\n\n---\n\n### Phase 4: New View Layout (4-Carousel Mode)\n\n#### Step 4.1: Create FourCarouselView Component\n**File:** &#96;Views/Components/FourCarouselView.swift&#96; (NEW)\n- Clone &#96;CombinedColumnView&#96; structure\n- Add 4th carousel for styles:\n  - Position: Bottom-aligned with preview drawer area\n  - Use same carousel component as others\n  - Bind to &#96;styleIndex&#96; and &#96;styleItems&#96;\n- Adjust layout:\n  - Shrink existing 3 carousels slightly (reduce tile size)\n  - Add 4th carousel row at bottom\n  - Ensure proper spacing\n\n#### Step 4.2: Update MainView to Switch Views\n**File:** &#96;Views/MainView.swift&#96;\n- Replace &#96;CombinedColumnView&#96; with conditional:\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;swift\n  if viewModel.viewMode == .default {\n      CombinedColumnView(...)\n  } else {\n      FourCarouselView(...)\n  }\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;\n- Pass all necessary bindings to both views\n- Ensure drawer and other overlays work with both views\n\n---\n\n### Phase 5: Generation Integration (4th Reference Image)",

Data(contentsOf: fileURL),\n              let image = UIImage(data: data) else {\n            return nil\n        }\n        \n        return image\n    }\n    \n    private func urlToFilename(url: URL) -&gt; String {\n        // Create a safe filename from URL\n        let urlString = url.absoluteString\n        let hash = urlString.hash\n        let ext = url.pathExtension.isEmpty ? \"png\" : url.pathExtension\n        return \"\\(abs(hash)).\\(ext)\"\n    }\n    \n    private func cleanOldCacheIfNeeded() {\n        let currentSize = cacheSize()\n        if currentSize &gt; maxDiskCacheSize {\n            // Remove oldest files (simple FIFO - remove files older than 7 days)\n            guard let files = try?         "contents": "    private func downloadAndCache(url: URL) async throws -&gt; UIImage? {\n        var request = URLRequest(url: url)\n        ServerConfig.shared.addAPIKeyHeader(to: &amp;request)\n        \n        let (data, response) = try await URLSession.shared.data(for: request)\n        \n        guard let httpResponse = response as? HTTPURLResponse else {\n            throw URLError(.badServerResponse)\n        }\n        \n        guard httpResponse.statusCode == 200 else {\n            // Provide more specific error information\n            if httpResponse.statusCode == 404 {\n                print(\"⚠️ ImageCache: File not found (404): \\(url.absoluteString)\")\n                throw URLError(.fileDoesNotExist)\n            } else if httpResponse.statusCode == 401 {\n                print(\"⚠️ ImageCache: Unauthorized (401): \\(url.absoluteString) - Check API key\")\n                throw URLError(.userAuthenticationRequired)\n            } else {\n                print(\"⚠️ ImageCache: Server error (\\(httpResponse.statusCode)): \\(url.absoluteString)\")\n                throw URLError(.badServerResponse)\n            }\n        }\n        \n        guard let image = UIImage(data: data) else {\n            print(\"⚠️ ImageCache: Invalid image data: \\(url.absoluteString)\")\n            throw URLError(.cannotDecodeContentData)\n        }\n        \n        // Store in both caches\n        storeInMemory(image: image, for: url)\n        storeOnDisk(image: image, data: data, url: url)\n        \n        return image\n    }\n    \n    private func storeInMemory(image: UIImage, for url: URL) {\n        // Estimate memory cost (rough calculation)\n        let cost = Int(image.size.width * image.size.height * 4) // 4 bytes per pixel (RGBA)\n        memoryCache.setObject(image, forKey: url.absoluteString as NSString, cost: cost)\n    }\n    \n    private func storeOnDisk(image: UIImage, data: Data, url: URL) {\n        let filename = urlToFilename(url: url)\n        let fileURL = cacheDirectory.appendingPathComponent(filename)",

String)\n                }\n                \n                self.finishImageGeneration()\n            } else if status == \"error\" {\n                let message = json[\"message\"] as? String ?? \"Unknown error\"\n                print(\"❌ Image generation error from server: \\(message)\")\n                self.handleImageGenerationError(NSError(domain: \"ImageGeneration\", code: -1, userInfo: [NSLocalizedDescriptionKey: message]))\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func addImageToHistory(imageURL: String, prompt: String?) {\n        // Extract filename from URL (e.g., \"/static/generated/image_id.png\" -&gt; \"image_id.png\")\n        let filename = imageURL.split(separator: \"/\").last ?? \"unknown.png\"\n        \n        // Create new GeneratedImage (prepend to history for LIFO)\n        let newImage = GeneratedImage(\n            url: imageURL,\n            filename: String(filename),\n            createdAt: Date().timeIntervalSince1970,\n            prompt: prompt,\n            recipeItems: nil,\n            deleted: false\n        )\n        \n        // Prepend to history (LIFO - newest first)\n        historyImages.insert(newImage, at: 0)\n        print(\"📸 Added new image to history: \\(filename) (total: \\(historyImages.count))\")\n        \n        // Also reload from server after a short delay to ensure we have the latest data\n        DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 1.0) { [weak self] in\n            self?.loadHistory()\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func finishImageGeneration() {\n        // Reset state",

        "contents": "    func getCachedImage(for url: URL) -&gt; UIImage? {\n        // Check memory cache\n        if let cachedImage = memoryCache.object(forKey: url.absoluteString as NSString) {\n            return cachedImage\n        }\n        \n        // Check disk cache\n        return loadFromDisk(url: url)\n    }\n    \n    /// Clear all caches\n    func clearCache() {\n        memoryCache.removeAllObjects()\n        try?         "contents": "    \n    private func loadUserImages() async {\n        print(\"🎮 MemoryGame: Loading user-generated images...\")\n        \n        do {\n            let images = try await apiClient.getGeneratedImages().async()\n            \n            // Filter out deleted images\n            let availableImages = images.filter { $0.deleted != true }\n            \n            guard !availableImages.isEmpty else {\n                await MainActor.run {\n                    gameState.isLoading = false\n                    gameState.errorMessage = \"No images found!         "contents": "            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func loadCardImages(cards: inout [MemoryCard]) async {\n        print(\"🖼️ MemoryGame: Loading \\(cards.count) card images...\")\n        \n        // Load unique images (each image URL appears twice, so we only need to load once per URL)\n        var imageCache: [String: UIImage] = [:]\n        let uniqueURLs = Set(cards.map { $0.imageURL })\n        \n        for urlString in uniqueURLs {\n            guard let url = URL(string: urlString) else {\n                print(\"⚠️ MemoryGame: Invalid URL: \\(urlString)\")\n                continue\n            }\n            \n            do {\n                if let image = try await ImageCache.shared.loadImage(from: url) {\n                    imageCache[urlString] = image\n                    print(\"✅ MemoryGame: Loaded image: \\(urlString)\")\n                } else {\n                    print(\"⚠️ MemoryGame: Failed to load image: \\(urlString)\")\n                }\n            } catch {\n                print(\"❌ MemoryGame: Error loading image \\(urlString): \\(error)\")\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // Assign loaded images to cards\n        for i in 0..&lt;cards.count {\n            if let image = imageCache[cards[i].imageURL] {\n                cards[i].image = image\n            }\n        }\n        \n        print(\"✅ MemoryGame: Loaded \\(imageCache.count) unique images\")\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Game Actions\n    \n    func flipCard(cardId: UUID) {\n        guard !gameState.gameComplete else { return }",

        "contents": "1. **ServerConfig.shared**\n   - Provides base URL\n   - Game is independent of how URL is configured\n\n2. **ImageCache.shared**\n   - Asset caching service\n   - Game doesn't depend on main app for this\n\n3. **Standard Swift/SwiftUI**\n   - Foundation, SwiftUI, SpriteKit, AVFoundation\n   - No custom dependencies\n\n### What NOT to Depend On\n\n❌ **MainViewModel**  \n❌ **MainView**  \n❌ **Other minigames**  \n❌ **App-specific state** (unless via optional callbacks)\n\n---\n\n## Testing as Standalone\n\n### Method 1: Comment/Uncomment @main\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\n// In abbies_world_iosApp.swift\n// @main  // Comment this out\nstruct abbies_world_iosApp: App {\n    // ...\n}\n\n// In {GameName}StandaloneApp.swift\n@main  // Uncomment this\nstruct {GameName}StandaloneApp: App {\n    // ...\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Method 2: Separate Xcode Target (Better)\n\n1. Create new target in Xcode\n2. Set &#96;{GameName}StandaloneApp&#96; as the main entry point\n3. Include only game-specific files\n4. Can run both targets independently\n\n---\n\n## Asset Loading Pattern\n\n### Server Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n/static/assets/minigames/\n  {game_name}/\n    images/\n      backgrounds/\n      objects/\n      ui/\n    sounds/\n      background.mp3\n      victory.mp3\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Loading Code\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\nprivate func loadCriticalAssets() async {\n    let imageURLString = \"\\(assetBaseURL)/images/background.png\"\n    if let url = URL(string: imageURLString) {\n        do {\n            if let image = try await ImageCache.shared.loadImage(from: url) {\n                await MainActor.run {\n                    gameState.backgroundImage = image\n                }\n            }\n        } catch {\n            print(\"❌ Error loading background: \\(error)\")\n            // Continue gracefully - game can work without image\n        }\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Key Points:**\n- Use &#96;ImageCache.shared&#96; for caching\n- Handle errors gracefully\n- Continue game even if assets fail to load\n- Use &#96;MainActor.run&#96; for UI updates\n\n---\n\n## Example: Waypoint Navigation Game\n\n### Files:\n- &#96;WaypointGameStandaloneApp.swift&#96; ✅\n- &#96;Views/WaypointNavigationGame/WaypointNavigationView.swift&#96; ✅",

        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./docs/problem-solving/MUSIC_PLAYBACK_RISKS.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {

          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 123
          }
        },
        "contents": "**Probability:** Medium (iOS system behavior)\n\n---\n\n## 🟡 Medium Risks (Medium Impact, Medium Probability)\n\n### 4. **Network Failure on Startup**\n**Risk:** If server is unreachable on first launch, no music available.\n\n**Impact:**\n- No music plays (silent failure)\n- User doesn't know why music isn't working\n- Settings show empty playlist\n\n**Mitigation:**\n- **Cache-First Strategy:** Always check cache before network\n- **Graceful Degradation:** Show cached playlist even if network fails\n- **User Feedback:** Display \"Using cached playlist\" message if offline\n- **Retry Logic:** Background refresh when network becomes available\n\n**Probability:** Medium (depends on network reliability)\n\n---\n\n### 5. **Storage Space Issues**\n**Risk:** Caching all 5 MP3 files could use significant disk space (estimated 10-50MB).\n\n**Impact:**\n- Device storage warnings\n- Cache fails to save\n- App appears broken if cache is corrupted\n\n**Mitigation:**\n- **Lazy Caching:** Only cache songs as they're played (not all at once)\n- **Cache Size Limits:** Set maximum cache size (e.g., 100MB)\n- **Cache Cleanup:** Remove oldest cached files when limit reached\n- **Optional Caching:** Make disk cache optional (memory-only fallback)\n\n**Probability:** Low-Medium (depends on file sizes)\n\n---\n\n### 6. **State Persistence Bugs**\n**Risk:** UserDefaults or cache corruption causes music settings to reset or behave incorrectly.\n\n**Impact:**\n- Music plays when user disabled it\n- Shuffle state doesn't persist\n- Playlist gets corrupted\n\n**Mitigation:**\n- **Validation:** Verify cached data structure before using\n- **Defaults:** Always have safe fallback values\n- **Versioning:** Add version field to cached data for migration\n- **Error Recovery:** Clear corrupted cache and re-fetch\n\n**Probability:** Low-Medium (rare but possible)\n\n---\n\n### 7. **Threading Issues**\n**Risk:** &#96;AVAudioPlayer&#96; operations and UI updates on wrong threads.\n\n**Impact:**\n- Crashes\n- UI freezes\n- Playback stuttering\n\n**Mitigation:**\n- **MainActor:** All UI updates on &#96;@MainActor&#96;\n- **Async/Await:** Proper async handling for network operations",

$1.createdAt }\n                    self.historyImages = sorted\n                }\n            )\n            .store(in: &amp;cancellables)\n    }\n    \n    // Removed categorizeIngredients and enrichIngredientsWithAssets - carousels now load directly from Assets API\n    \n    private func setupCategoryMapping() {\n        // Category mapping is done in categorizeIngredients()\n        // You can extend this to support custom mappings\n    }\n    \n    func selectFriend(_ ingredient: Ingredient) {\n        // Selection tracking - can be used for future functionality\n    }\n    \n    func selectOutfit(_ ingredient: Ingredient) {\n        // Selection tracking - can be used for future functionality\n    }\n    \n    func selectPlace(_ ingredient: Ingredient) {\n        // Selection tracking - can be used for future functionality\n    }\n    \n    func selectStyle(_ ingredient: Ingredient) {\n        // Selection tracking for style/medium carousel\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Style Items (Placeholder)\n    \n    /// Load placeholder style items for the 4th carousel\n    /// These are placeholder ingredients with no actual images - style will be passed as text description\n    /// Each style has a display name (for UI) and a detailed prompt (for GPT)",
