        "contents": "**App Lifecycle:**\n- Start music playback when app becomes active (if enabled)\n- Pause music when app goes to background (optional - can continue)\n- Resume on foreground (if was playing)\n\n## Implementation Details\n\n### Caching Strategy\n\n**Memory Cache:**\n- Playlist stored in &#96;MusicService.playlist: [MusicTrack]&#96;\n- Current song audio data cached in &#96;AVAudioPlayer&#96; instance\n\n**Disk Cache:**\n- Playlist metadata cached to UserDefaults (JSON encoded)\n- Audio files cached to &#96;Documents/MusicCache/&#96; directory\n- Cache key: &#96;music_playlist_&lt;timestamp&gt;&#96;\n- On startup: Check cache age, refresh if &gt; 24 hours old\n\n**Cache Invalidation:**\n- Refresh playlist on app startup if cache is stale\n- Manual refresh option in Settings (future enhancement)\n\n### Playback Logic\n\n**Normal Playback:**\n1. Play songs in order: Track 1 → Track 2 → Track 3 → ...\n2. When last song ends:\n   - If repeat mode = &#96;.all&#96;: Loop back to first song\n   - If repeat mode = &#96;.none&#96;: Stop playback\n   - If repeat mode = &#96;.one&#96;: Repeat current song\n\n**Shuffle Playback:**\n1. Create shuffled queue on shuffle enable\n2. Maintain shuffle order until shuffle disabled\n3. When song ends, play next in shuffled queue\n4. If repeat = &#96;.all&#96;, reshuffle when queue exhausted\n\n**Song Selection:**\n1. User selects song from Settings\n2. Play selected song immediately\n3. After song completes:\n   - If shuffle enabled: Continue with shuffled queue (excluding played songs)\n   - If shuffle disabled: Continue with normal queue from selected song position\n\n### Error Handling\n\n- Network errors: Use cached playlist if available\n- Audio loading errors: Skip to next song, log error\n- Missing files: Remove from playlist, continue\n- Audio session errors: Log, disable music gracefully\n\n## File Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nabbies.world.ios/\n├── Models/\n│   └── MusicTrack.swift (NEW)\n├── Services/\n│   ├── MusicService.swift (NEW)\n│   └── AssetsService.swift (existing - will use)\n├── ViewModels/\n│   └── MusicSettingsViewModel.swift (NEW - optional, may not need)\n└── Views/\n    └── Components/\n        ",

        "contents": "//\n//  MemoryGameModels.swift\n//  abbies.world.ios\n//\n//  Created for Memory/Concentration Minigame using user-generated images\n//\n\nimport Foundation\nimport UIKit\nimport Combine\n\n// MARK: - Card State\n\nenum CardState {\n    case hidden      // Card is face down\n    case revealed    // Card is face up (temporarily shown)\n    case matched     // Card has been matched with its pair\n}\n\n// MARK: - Memory Card\n\nstruct MemoryCard: Identifiable {\n    let id: UUID\n    let imageURL: String\n    let imageFilename: String\n    var state: CardState\n    var image: UIImage?  // Loaded image\n    \n    init(imageURL: String, imageFilename: String) {\n        self.id = UUID()\n        self.imageURL = imageURL\n        self.imageFilename = imageFilename\n        self.state = .hidden\n        self.image = nil\n    }\n}\n\n// MARK: - Game Difficulty\n\nenum GameDifficulty: String, CaseIterable {\n    case easy = \"Easy\"      // 4 pairs (8 cards) - 2x4 grid\n    case medium = \"Medium\"  // 6 pairs (12 cards) - 3x4 grid\n    case hard = \"Hard\"      // 8 pairs (16 cards) - 4x4 grid\n    \n    var pairCount: Int {\n        switch self {\n        case .easy: return 4\n        case .medium: return 6\n        case .hard: return 8\n        }\n    }\n    \n    var gridColumns: Int {\n        switch self {\n        case .easy: return 2\n        case .medium: return 3\n        case .hard: return 4\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// MARK: - Game State\n\nclass MemoryGameState: ObservableObject {\n    @Published var cards: [MemoryCard] = []\n    @Published var flippedCards: [UUID] = []  // Currently revealed cards (max 2)",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "//",
            "lineNumber": 1

Proposal for the history gallery improvements:

## Proposal: History Gallery Enhancement

### Overview
Add:
1. Image detail modal — tap a history image to view it large with like/close actions
2. Liked images gallery — full-screen gallery accessible via a heart button
3. Persistent likes — store liked status locally

### Implementation Plan

#### 1. Data model and persistence
- Add a `LikedImagesService` to manage liked image IDs (using `UserDefaults`)
- Track likes by image `id` (filename) since that's the unique identifier
- No server changes needed — likes are client-side only

#### 2. Image detail modal
- Full-screen overlay with:
  - Large image (centered, aspect-fit)
  - Close button (top-left, X icon)
  - Heart button (top-right, filled when liked)
  - Tap outside to close
  - Smooth animations

#### 3. Liked images gallery
- Heart button next to the game icon (top-right, between settings and games)
- Opens a full-screen gallery showing only liked images
- Large format carousel for browsing
- Swipe between images
- Show count badge on heart button if there are liked images

#### 4. UI/UX details
- Heart button states: outline (not liked) vs filled (liked)
- Smooth animations for like/unlike
- Gallery shows empty state if no liked images
- Maintain current history carousel behavior

### Technical approach

**New files:**
1. `LikedImagesService.swift` — manages liked image IDs
2. `ImageDetailModal.swift` — full-screen image viewer
3. `LikedImagesGalleryView.swift` — full-screen liked images gallery

**Modified files:**
1. `MainViewModel.swift` — add liked images management
2. `MainView.swift` — add heart button and modal states
3. `RightColumnView.swift` — handle image selection to open modal

### Questions/considerations
1. Persistence: Use `UserDefaults` for simplicity (no server sync needed)
2. Gallery navigation: Swipe between images or use a carousel?
3. Badge: Show count on heart button?
4. Empty state: Message when no liked images?

### Benefits
- Simple, local-only implementation
- No server changes
- Clear visual feedback
- Easy to share/show favorites
- Fits existing UI patterns

Should I proceed with this implementation? Any changes to the proposal?
